summary: NuCana plc announced the appointment of Ian Webster as permanent Chief Financial Officer, effective June 1, 2026, via a Form 6-K filing with a press release. Mr. Webster had served as Interim CFO since June 2025 and previously as Director of Finance since 2019. The change is a routine management succession, not forced or abrupt; it formalizes an existing interim role. No financial terms, advisor, or board recommendation are provided. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report. Given the routine nature and lack of material special-situation triggers, this is classified as a management change but borders on ordinary course. Watch for any subsequent strategic implications tied to NuCana's pipeline milestones and cash runway into 2029.
